title: Thai-Style Beef Larb Buns
description: A twist on traditional Japanese buns, these bite-sized treats are filled with spicy Thai-style beef larb. Perfect as an appetizer or snack.
instructions: 1. Cook the mung bean noodles according to package instructions.
2. In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
4. Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
5. Stir in the fish sauce and lime juice.
6. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
8. To assemble the buns, spread a small amount of the beef larb mixture onto the bottom of each bun.
9. Top with cooked noodles and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
